item.title: 0.6.3-beta.1
item.description:
# Agent HUD 0.6.3-beta.1
## Compatibility
**Requires Agent HUD for iPhone 1.7.2 or later** for iPhone and Apple Watch sync. Update the iPhone app before updating the Mac. Older iPhone versions cannot read this release's data.
[Get the iPhone app](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6812113619).
If the required iPhone version is not yet on the App Store, cross-device features require the corresponding TestFlight version.
Requires an Apple Silicon Mac running macOS 14 or later.
## Changes
### New
- Speaks nine languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, French, German, Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese. Pick one in Settings → General → Language, or let it follow the system. - Adds "Take me around" to the card that tells what an update adds. It starts the getting-started tour beside the HUD, and the card counts as read. - Reads Qoder, QoderWork, TRAE, WorkBuddy, CodeBuddy, ZCode and MiniMax Code accounts from each app's own sign-in. Each region is its own account: Qoder CN, TRAE CN and CodeBuddy CN show apart from the international ones. - Lets agents start DeepSeek Harness sessions, through Agent HUD's plugin in a running Harness. With none running, the Harness desktop app opens. - Lets an agent that reads the answer itself leave out the reply line (#75). With `reply_hint: false` on `send_message` or `start_session`, the message ends by asking the recipient to answer in its turn, instead of sending a message back. - Opens the windows a sign-in page asks for beside the sign-in window, and presents the system's own browser to the site, so sign-ins that open a second window or check the browser go through.
### Fixes
- Delivers agent messages to Antigravity on Windows (#77). Finding Antigravity's server took over 6 seconds on some computers, longer than a message may wait, so every message was refused. It now takes milliseconds. - Stops marking CodeBuddy, Qoder CN and QoderWork as "Requests only" on the Remote page; their conversations sync to the phone too.

# Agent HUD 0.5.5
## Compatibility
**Requires Agent HUD for iPhone 1.5 or later** for iPhone and Apple Watch sync. Update the iPhone app before updating the Mac. Older iPhone versions cannot read this release's data.
[Get the iPhone app](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6812113619).
Requires an Apple Silicon Mac running macOS 14 or later.
## Changes
### Quota names on every device
- Keeps quota window names and short forms in English, so an English iPhone, widget or Apple Watch no longer receives Chinese names from a Mac using Chinese. Names update after the Mac reads and syncs the account again.
### Docks and appearance
- Keeps every logo visible on Simple and Dynamic docks while a reply or request opens beside the sending agent's logo. - Gives each display its own dark, light or system appearance, solid or glass material and transparency. Settings → General can match windows to their display's HUD as an experimental option. - Lets both dock sizes run from 20 to 60 pt, adds Simple panel logo spacing and uses one smaller text size for dock numbers, reminders and the hover line. - Makes the agents' bots act out thinking, tools, approvals, questions, plans, compaction, failures and usage limits. Claude's bot is Clawd. - Keeps the menu bar's figure, colours and agent order in step with the main display's HUD and its layout.
### Arrange the HUD with an agent
- Adds client checkmarks and add/remove actions for the MCP server in Settings → Experimental. - Names the tools `get_hud`, `get_hud_screenshot`, `draft_hud`, `discard_hud_draft` and `finish_hud_edit`. The server remains `agent-hud`; turn on the renamed HUD tools switch again to use it. - Lets an agent filter sessions by project and period, choose block accounts and row order, change panel switches and propose app settings as a draft for you to save. - Holds the panel open while an agent arranges it, then lets go when the edit finishes or you dismiss it. - Adds balance burn rates, estimated run-out times and cost charts to API balance blocks.
### Sessions and other agents
- Removes archived or deleted sessions from session lists while keeping their tokens in the usage totals until the ledger expires them. - Lets a session using a tool take over an agent's mark from one that is thinking. - Answers Claude Code plan approvals on the HUD, including accepting edits or returning feedback to keep planning. - Ends Claude Code turns promptly when their logs report a usage limit or API failure. - Keeps one provider order across Settings, the HUD, glow, menu bar and token statistics. - Shows WorkBuddy's model ceilings and credits, reads a GLM plan held only by WorkBuddy under that group and handles a CodeBuddy CLI using WorkBuddy's configuration as WorkBuddy. - Reduces artwork memory, repeated island layout and process inspection for clients that are not installed.
### iPhone and Apple Watch sync
- Sends Claude's narrations and questions to the phone, including questions answered through the Claude desktop app's next-step box. - Keeps published turn text once and improves local-network change tracking and conversation-cache recovery. - Ships the Mac executable stripped and the updater for Apple Silicon only, while keeping debugging symbols locally for crash reports.
